pull_request.body:
## Summary
Fix the Network & API settings card when FirmDeck runs as a web service without the desktop launcher runtime snapshot.

## Changes
- Derive active runtime network data from trusted web-process configuration only when the desktop snapshot is absent.
- Preserve the desktop snapshot priority and avoid reflecting caller-controlled Host headers.
- Add a regression test for a public web runtime.

## Testing
- `backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/test_api_endpoint_settings.py backend/tests/test_runtime_network.py backend/tests/test_desktop_launcher.py -q` (56 passed)
- `npm --prefix frontend-enterprise test` (273 passed)
- `npm --prefix frontend-enterprise run build` (passed)
- `backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests -q` (2048 passed; 8 unrelated environment failures because the sandbox cannot create its runtime lock under Application Support)
- `backend/.venv/bin/ruff check --ignore B008 backend/app/api/ui_config.py backend/tests/test_api_endpoint_settings.py` (passed)

## Affected route and role
- `/enterprise/settings` for tenant administrators.

## Risks
Web deployments should provide `APP_HOST`/`APP_PORT` (or `ULTRARAG_HOST`/`ULTRARAG_PORT`) and set `FIRMDECK_PUBLIC_URL` when an external public origin is available. No schema or migration changes.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved network configuration detection when running without a desktop runtime.
  * Network settings now use trusted server configuration instead of client-provided host information.
  * Added clearer error handling for invalid network settings.
  * Correctly generates local and public API URLs from configured host, port, and public URL values.

**Use the listener’s host and port configuration together.**

When `APP_HOST` is set, `APP_PORT` is unset, and `ULTRARAG_PORT` is set, `_web_runtime_network()` reports `APP_HOST` with `ULTRARAG_PORT`. The Web supervisor starts Uvicorn with `APP_HOST` and the default `APP_PORT` (`5173`), so the displayed endpoint can differ from the listener. Mirror the listener’s paired configuration and add a regression case for this partial configuration.

<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
In `@backend/app/api/ui_config.py` around lines 347 - 351, Update
_web_runtime_network to resolve host and port from the same configuration pair,
so APP_HOST uses APP_PORT or its default without falling back to ULTRARAG_PORT;
likewise preserve the ULTRARAG host/port pairing when that configuration is
selected. Add a regression case covering APP_HOST set, APP_PORT unset, and
ULTRARAG_PORT set, verifying the reported endpoint matches the Web supervisor
listener.
```

</details>
